verdict.rationale: Base44 is primarily a prompt-driven builder ('Describe what you want in natural language, and AI updates code, styles, and components for you' — docs-33), meaning most edits require a prompt round-trip. There is a narrow direct-control exception for global theme settings ('Set colors and fonts for your entire app from one place' — docs-13), but no evidence of a select-an-element-and-directly-edit-text/layout canvas interface. missing for 10: evidence of a WYSIWYG/direct-manipulation editor for selecting individual elements and editing text/layout without invoking AI, independent hands-on confirmation of non-prompt editing.
